21.105.note: Reserved bits must be zero. This LTE/system structure is not offered for ordinary group-value transfer.

21.106.name: StatusAHU
21.106.note: Reserved bits must be zero. This LTE/system structure is not offered for ordinary group-value transfer.

26.001.name: SceneInfo
26.001.note: Bit 6 is 0 for scene active and 1 for scene inactive; it is not a learn/store flag.

206.100.name: HVACModeNext
206.100.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means undefined; zero mode means undefined. Allowed combinations depend on the datapoint specification. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.102.name: DHWModeNext
206.102.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means undefined; zero mode means undefined. Allowed combinations depend on the datapoint specification. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.104.name: OccModeNext
206.104.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means next mode not available. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.105.name: BuildingModeNext
206.105.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means next mode not available. Not available in Standard Mode.

238.600.name: DALI_Diagnostics
238.600.note: Diagnostic status: two failure flags followed by a six-bit DALI device address.

242.600.name: Colour_xyY
242.600.note: x and y are rounded onto 0–65535; brightness uses DPT 5.001 scaling. Independent validity flags; reserved bits zero. Encoding does not establish that a colour is physically achievable.

244.600.name: Converter_Status
244.600.note: Converter mode and hardware status followed by four two-bit status enums. Unlisted enum codes are reserved; hardware bits 2 and 3 must be zero.

248.600.name: Converter_Info_Fix

fields.label: Rated duration (raw byte; KNX scaling unconfirmed)
Maintained gear (KNX); Ed. 2: maintained non-controllable, type C
Switched maintained gear (KNX); Ed. 2: maintained controllable, type A/B

248.600.note: RatedDur is preserved as a raw byte. DALI interpretation per IEC 62386-202:2022: raw × 2 min; 255 = 510 min or longer. Applying this interpretation to KNX assumes the gateway passes the DALI byte unchanged; KNX-level scaling remains unconfirmed. GearFeat uses KNX names: bit 1 maintained gear differs from Edition 2 maintained non-controllable (type C); bit 2 switched maintained differs from Edition 2 maintained controllable (type A/B). Edition 2 fixes bits 3 and 7 to 1 and bit 6 to 0; these constraints are not imposed on this KNX codec.

6.020.name: Status_Mode3
6.020.note: Five status bits use 0 = set, 1 = clear. The final three bits select mode 0 (001), mode 1 (010) or mode 2 (100). Other mode codes are reserved.

7.010.name: PropDataType
7.010.note: Unsigned property datatype identifier. A numeric value does not establish an assigned property datatype.

16.001.name: String_8859_1
16.001.note: Fixed 14-byte ISO 8859-1 string. Shorter strings are NULL padded; embedded NULLs are not accepted.

20.1001.name: AddInfoTypes
20.1001.note: Only explicitly defined enumeration codes are accepted. System/property type; ordinary group-value transfer is disabled.

20.1002.name: RF_ModeSelect
20.1002.note: Only explicitly defined enumeration codes are accepted. System/property type; ordinary group-value transfer is disabled.

20.1004.name: Medium
20.1004.note: Only explicitly defined enumeration codes are accepted. System/property type; ordinary group-value transfer is disabled.

21.001.name: StatusGen
21.001.note: General status: b0 out of service, b1 fault, b2 overridden, b3 in alarm, b4 alarm unacknowledged. b5–b7 reserved. This is status information, not the LTE command interpretation.

21.1000.name: RF_ModeInfo
21.1000.note: Asynchronous support must be 1. The upper five bits are reserved. System type; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

21.1010.name: Channel_Activation_8
21.1010.note: Bit n indicates the visual-effect activation state of channel n+1. System type; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

22.1010.name: Channel_Activation_16
22.1010.note: Bit n indicates the visual-effect activation state of channel n+1. System type; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

30.1010.name: Channel_Activation_24
30.1010.note: Bit n indicates the visual-effect activation state of channel n+1. System type; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

22.100.name: StatusDHWC
22.100.note: DHW controller LTE status. Bits 8–15 are reserved. Standard mode uses separate Boolean datapoints; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

22.101.name: StatusRHCC
22.101.note: Room HVAC controller status. Bit 8 is 0 cooling / 1 heating; bit 15 is reserved. Other named bits indicate their respective states.

25.1000.name: DoubleNibble
25.1000.note: Two nibbles: Busy repetitions followed by Inack repetitions, each restricted to 0–3. System type; ordinary group transfer is disabled.

27.001.name: CombinedInfoOnOff
27.001.note: Combined binary output status only. High 16 bits are validity masks; low 16 bits are output states. Ignore a stored state when its corresponding validity bit is 0.

249.600.name: Brightness_Colour_Temperature_Transition
249.600.note: Six-byte value: time in 100 ms steps, colour temperature in K, scaled brightness and three validity bits. Ignore fields whose validity bit is 0. The printed format line says four octets, but diagram, widths and PDT_GENERIC_06 establish six.

250.600.name: Brightness_Colour_Temperature_Control
250.600.note: Each component occupies a padded direction/step octet. Step 0 stops; 1–7 specify relative steps. Validity bits use 0 = ignore, 1 = valid.

252.600.name: Relative_Control_RGBW
252.600.note: Each component occupies a padded direction/step octet. Step 0 stops; 1–7 specify relative steps. Validity bits use 0 = ignore, 1 = valid.

253.600.name: Relative_Control_xyY
253.600.note: Each component occupies a padded direction/step octet. Step 0 stops; 1–7 specify relative steps. Validity bits use 0 = ignore, 1 = valid.

254.600.name: Relative_Control_RGB
254.600.note: Each component occupies a padded direction/step octet. Step 0 stops; 1–7 specify relative steps. No validity-mask octet is present.

251.600.name: Colour_RGBW
251.600.note: Six octets: R, G, B, W percentages, a reserved zero octet, then r4 + R/G/B/W validity. Ignore component values whose validity bit is 0.

257.1200.name: Value_Electric_Current_3
257.1200.note: Three IEEE 754 binary32 values in phase 1, 2, 3 order. This codec supports finite values only; special IEEE encodings are not measurements.

257.1201.name: Value_Electric_Potential_3
257.1201.note: Three IEEE 754 binary32 values in phase 1, 2, 3 order. This codec supports finite values only; special IEEE encodings are not measurements.

257.1202.name: Value_ApparentPower_3
257.1202.note: Three IEEE 754 binary32 values in phase 1, 2, 3 order. This codec supports finite values only; special IEEE encodings are not measurements.

272.600.name: Converter_Info
272.600.note: Seven octets: information validity, emergency and total lamp hours, emergency level and DALI short address. Information validity 0 or 2 means the remaining values are not current valid information. Level 255 means unknown.

276.1200.name: ERL_Status
276.1200.note: Three scaled duty cycles followed by five status bits. Duty-cycle alarms indicate the 98% threshold; upper three status bits are reserved.
